title: Curate MicrobeDecoder traits, process meanings, and material contexts
body:
## Summary

Continues #650 with finite, evidence-backed MicrobeDecoder interpretation rather than treating every preserved source value as a missing chemical mapping.

- Add 35 exact field/literal Attribute node types (22 textual, nine independently verified numeric/sign codes, four FAPROTAX traits). Native METPO classes remain ontology-owned; no invented `has_attribute_type` edge or universal organism phenotype is introduced.
- Review all 61 remaining process labels: two GO routes, four typed and ten untyped source-attribute dispositions, and 45 source-local process definitions with source-scoped identities and immutable vocabulary evidence. FAPROTAX predictions remain predictions.
- Add a record-bound material-review catalogue for 240 assertions / 235 raw records / 13 existing local IDs, retaining unresolved chemical identities and the two approved record-scoped sugar nodes. This is inventory metadata, not a transform mapping or MIM pin change.
- Extend the complete source inventory with strict type/provenance, source-scope and optional closed-material-cohort checks.
- Correct the source citation and LPSN name-record grain in the runbook; preserve raw observations and contradictory values.

Fixes #1219: typed source Attribute nodes with missing or incorrect `provided_by` must not pass inventory review.

Fixes #1221: distinguish the historical #1218 review from the current evidence and document all 35 current source-value rules.

Fixes #1222: check present MicrobeDecoder Attribute type slots against unique active native METPO declarations, and explicitly report the untyped source-preservation profile exception instead of implying full LinkML conformance.

Fixes #1223: reject ambiguous source-node headers and ragged rows before dictionary parsing; honor canonical QUOTE_NONE so literal quotes cannot hide an invalid type or corrupt source names.

## Review and validation

Independent adversarial reviews cover the original Attribute model, source/process integration, material catalogue, inventory, nine-code extension, and source-model-review diagnostics. Findings were filed as #1219, #1221, #1222 and #1223; the duplicate-header and quote-dialect corrections received separate independent scrutiny. All final gates passed on frozen head `f24eb090d76e304201d27154e839e617c9e3fa74`: `poetry run pytest` and the pytest stage of `poetry run tox` each report 4,671 passed / 22 skipped; all other tox stages, `poetry check --lock`, and `python scripts/generate_merge_configs.py --check` passed. The tracked worktree stayed clean and the tested head did not change. Exact-head GitHub CI passed on Python 3.10, 3.11 and 3.12 (run 36533603187).

Final local gate receipt: `data/curation-goal-20260928.LFUKxk/final-gates-parallel-stdqnqo4/results.json`, SHA-256 `abc5e80acdc012851d37c9d03a606fdfe60f8a7a18240401b364351ef1181758`. Earlier interrupted or pre-fix test attempts are not final acceptance.

Focused checks pass, including 997 MicrobeDecoder tests, registered-finalization tests, and real KGX archive round trips of the new node properties. Lock consistency and generated merge-config checks pass.

The isolated actual-producer replay passed: 20,364 finalized nodes and 521,217 edges; all 61 reviewed process labels account for 41,388 intentional edge changes, and the other 479,829 rows remain byte-identical. An independent full-row multiset comparison checked multiplicity and every original edge field. The 35 typed Attribute nodes, 45 source-defined process nodes, 66,075 normalization-sidecar uses, and complete 240-use/235-record material cohort were verified. All 48 protected input/production files remained unchanged. Rejected or interrupted earlier attempts are retained and are not acceptance evidence.

Review/replay evidence is retained under `data/curation-goal-20260928.LFUKxk/`; accepted replay receipt: `source-replay/attempt-rmf78hj4/acceptance-result.json`, SHA-256 `b3e3612f2ed9267a2df477eeedcf6922fdbbb6f9630483e2930f53d13753a65c`.

## Scope limits

This PR does not certify production outputs, the merged KG, or release readiness. It does not close the parent #650 before fresh production rebuild and acceptance. Source-local process meanings are not exact native ontology matches; reviewed material context does not resolve its chemical identity. Other measurements, units, isolation context, generic spores and unsupported assay codes remain explicitly preserved source observations.

Path spot-checking identified separate preexisting source-quality issue #1224: raw Methylocystis record 10902 contains contradictory Enterococcus NCBI/GOLD cross-references. The five old/new crosswalk rows are unchanged; the new GO mapping stays anchored to the correctly named LPSN record and preserves prediction provenance. Correcting those cross-references is not part of this finite-label patch, and no semantically clean-crosswalk or release claim is made. Source-only endpoint findings also retain the known 18,374 external IMG references described in #1073.

No production graph, MIM pin, unified mappings, unrelated branch or user statistics file is changed.
